notes: Assumptions that move the number: the beef is taken as cubed boneless chuck with its fat (USDA under-blade, 13 % fat; the leaner USDA 'chuck for stew' at 4.5 % fat would lower each plate by ~135 kcal, and bone-in pieces at ~80 % edible would lower it by ~80 kcal); all 3 tbsp oil eaten; stock from 1.5 cubes. Each plate has 200 g raw beef and a dumpling made from 80 g flour (~275 kcal). Compared against: Olive magazine beef stew with herby dumplings 773 kcal (serves 4), BBC Good Food ME beef and bean stew with cornbread dumplings 642 kcal, delicious. magazine quick stew and dumplings 593 kcal. Ours is 11 % above the closest and ~35 % above the lighter two. The gap is portion size: those use 125-150 g beef and smaller dumplings a plate.
